investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell script attempted to dump LSASS memory using rundll32 with comsvcs.dll, writing a debug_report.log to C:\Windows\Temp. This behavior is commonly associated with credential dumping or memory scraping and is not consistent with routine administrative activity on SRV-FILE-02. The combination of accessing the LSASS process and using a system utility to create a memory dump on a server without a clear legitimate justification makes this high risk.
investigation_notes.Scriptblock:
$l = (Get-Process lsass).Id
rundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump $l C:\Windows\Temp\debug_report.log full
